description: This PHP source file defines the BlockTheme class, a deprecated Drupal migration process plugin responsible for determining the theme to use for a block during migration. It includes methods for constructing the plugin, creating instances via dependency injection, and transforming theme values based on available themes and configuration.

classes.name: BlockTheme
classes.description: A deprecated Drupal migration process plugin class that determines the theme for a block during migration, based on source theme data and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the BlockTheme object with configuration, theme configuration, and available themes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin using dependency injection container.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the theme value during migration, mapping source themes to destination themes based on configuration and available themes.
